title: add vpc control plane: terraform multi-az interface endpoints, peering, route53, sgs, subnets
author: Samir Patel
release_notes: Adds Terraform modules and installer config for multi-AZ VPC control plane provisioning: subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account VPC peering, and Route53 private hosted zone peering. Includes upgrade/rollback hooks for the private installer and migration guidance.
description:
Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private need a repeatable, multi-AZ Terraform module that provisions VPC networking for the control plane with secure interface endpoints, minimal blast radius security groups, cross-account peering support, and Route53 private hosted zone peering for DNS resolution. This PR bundles module updates, Helm/installer value defaults, upgrade/rollback hooks, and CI smoke tests.

What this change does: Adds a new terraform/modules/vpc-control-plane module that creates: private subnets across provided AZs, interface endpoints (ssm, ec2, ecr, secretsmanager) and optional gateway endpoints, security groups with least-privilege rules for control plane components, cross-account VPC peering resources with automated route creation, and Route53 association/peering configuration (supports both AWS-managed peering and Route53 Resolver rules for cross-account DNS). The private-installer Helm chart gains values to toggle interface vs gateway endpoints, configure peering mode, and supply an external account id for cross-account deployments. An upgrade/rollback hook script is added to handle route table migration and DNS associations during live upgrades. Updated docs and examples + terraform tests and an integration smoke pipeline are included.

Checklist:
- [x] Terraform module implemented and unit-tested with terraform validate/plan
- [x] Helm value defaults and templates updated
- [x] Upgrade/rollback hook script and idempotent migration logic added
- [x] Integration smoke test job added to CI to run a minimal provision/validate/destroy
- [x] Docs and example usage updated under docs/private-deploy/vpc-provisioning.md

Migration notes: existing customers should run the included migration plan against a staging environment; the module will by default not delete or replace subnets, and peering is opt-in. The upgrade hook will automatically create temporary routes to avoid DNS blackholing during swap. See docs for step-by-step guidance and Terraform workspaces recommendation.

Security: all new resources are tagged and created with resource-level tags; SGs default to narrow CIDR ranges and the module accepts a list of trusted CIDRs. Cross-account peering requires an explicit external_account_id and manual acceptance step to avoid accidental peering.

Related: ENG-4218, PM-972, SUP-2891.
commits: 4 commits: feat(terraform): add vpc-control-plane module with subnets/endpoints/peering; feat(installer): expose endpoint and peering toggles in Helm values; fix(ci): add vpc smoke integration job and retries; docs: add vpc-provisioning guide and migration notes.
